name: R1 Grounded Interaction
ascii:
Legend: [D] = interaction data/surface, (O) = user operation. Back/Forward arrows are pane history.

                         R1 REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

 (O) Select DiagramSet (`DiagramSetTreePanel`)
       |
       v
 (O) Navigate grouped lineage (`DiagramLineagePanel`)
       |
       +-- candidate batches / ranked lineage candidates
       +-- diagram variants / call graphs / directory views / edits / derivatives / imports
       +-- select a component or information-ranked Representation layer
       `-- star the preferred view (`DiagramCandidateFeedbackDialog`)
       |
       v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] Active Representation                                                        |
|     orientation and manipulation surface                                         |
|                                                                                   |
|  (O) DiagramView renders the active artifact                                      |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  (O) AsciiSelectionGrid presents selectable ASCII                                 |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [D] revision-scoped RepresentationIndex (`representationIndex`)                  |
|      stable tree-node and mapped-element identities                               |
|      mapped / highlighted presentation state                                      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       v
 [D] Stable RepresentationIndex element
       |
       +----> (O) Pointer and selection (`DiagramSelectionOverlay`)
       |            +-- hover a stable mapped element
       |            +-- click a mapped element -> resolve Evidence
       |            +-- rectangle selection
       |            `-- display mapped / highlighted state
       |
       +----> (O) Mapped-element commands (`ElementCommandId`, App handlers)
       |            +-- reveal Evidence ------> grounding path below
       |            +-- collapse subtree -----> presentation-only
       |            +-- toggle highlight -----> durable grounded context
       |            `-- buffer reference -----> mapped Evidence in temporary tray
       |
       +----> (O) Progressive disclosure (`callGraphFocus`, `representationGraph`)
       |            +-- collapse by stable subtree identity
       |            +-- selected Evidence -> focused Call Graph in transient pane
       |            `-- layer / transition feedback (`RepresentationLayersPanel`)
       |
       `----> (O) Artifact manipulation (`diagramSelection`, `EditOperationsPanel`)
                    +-- selected rectangle -> capture DiagramComponent
                    `-- edit mode: markers; manual/LLM edits; undo/redo;
                        publish an immutable lineage child

 Transient panes, layers, components, and focused views return to the active Representation.

                 ONLY GROUNDED SOURCE-REVEAL PATH

+------------------------+   mapped element   +----------------------+   authoritative ranges   +------------------+
| [D] REPRESENTATION     | -----------------> | [D] EVIDENCE         | -----------------------> | [D] CORPUS       |
| orient / manipulate    | <----------------- | grounded hinge       | <----------------------- | verify claims    |
+------------------------+   pane Back/Forward+----------------------+    pane Back/Forward     +------------------+
                 Reversible pane history returns through Evidence to Representation.

Rule: every Representation-initiated source reveal must pass through Evidence; no direct jump to Corpus.
Explicit Corpus browsing is separate from a Representation-initiated reveal.

R1 BOUNDARY: interaction begins only after a Representation appears.
Excluded: evidence collection; agent generation; reference follow-up; mapping prompt execution;
          persistence layout.
